caseName: Local 182, International Brotherhood of Teamsters v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Local 182, International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: John T. Buckley for appellant., Solicitor General Griswold, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli, and Norton J. Come for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
